# Coastal Bronze Spray Tanning

> Coastal Bronze Spray Tanning is a Holiday, Florida spray tan studio and mobile spray tanning provider serving Pasco, Pinellas, and Hillsborough counties with custom NUDA airbrush tans, bridal tanning, mobile appointments, memberships, prep guidance, and retail tan-care products.

Coastal Bronze Spray Tanning was founded in 2024 by Mackenzie, a NUDA-certified spray tan trainer. The business provides in-studio custom spray tans in Holiday, FL for clients near Holiday, Tarpon Springs, and New Port Richey, plus mobile spray tans for homes, hotels, Airbnbs, businesses, bridal suites, events, and tanning parties throughout Pasco, Pinellas, and Hillsborough counties.

Primary entity facts: business name Coastal Bronze Spray Tanning; address 3144 Gina Court, Holiday, FL 34691; phone (727) 316-5702; email coastalbronzespraytanning@gmail.com; hours Monday-Sunday 8am to 8pm; Instagram @coastalbronzetans; Google rating claim used on the site: over 50 5-star reviews.

Booking is handled through Square links on the relevant service pages. Mobile spray tans currently start at $100 before travel fees. First-time in-studio clients pay $60, returning in-studio clients pay $70, and the Monthly Glow Membership is $99 for 2 tans in a 30-day period.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.coastalbronzespraytanning.com/): Main page for custom spray tans in Holiday, FL, in-studio appointments, mobile service coverage, reviews, services, pricing, booking links, Instagram photos, and business contact details.
- [Service Area Hub](https://www.coastalbronzespraytanning.com/service-areas/): County-grouped mobile spray tan service area hub linking to individual city pages across Pasco, Pinellas, Hillsborough, and nearby communities.
- [FAQs](https://www.coastalbronzespraytanning.com/faqs): Spray tan questions and answers covering booking, pricing, prep, aftercare, mobile appointments, tan longevity, and policies.
- [Prep and Post Spray Tan Care](https://www.coastalbronzespraytanning.com/prep-and-post-spray-tan-care): Client preparation and aftercare instructions for before, during, and after a custom spray tan appointment.
- [Cancellation Policy](https://www.coastalbronzespraytanning.com/cancellation-policy): Appointment cancellation, late cancellation, no-show, and travel policy details.
- [Monthly Glow Membership](https://www.coastalbronzespraytanning.com/membership): $99 Monthly Glow Membership page with signup link, details, terms, and member benefits.
- [Retail Products](https://www.coastalbronzespraytanning.com/retail): Retail tan-care product page for Bronze Boost Tanning Water, Bronze Glow Tan Extender, and the Bronze Glow Maintenance Bundle.
